subtitle.en: THE LAB  ·  THE CODE LAB  ·  CHALLENGES

why.zh: 从真实页面录下的操作演示：单步看 A、B 同序得到 H 边、A、D 交叉得到 V 边，点块 E 看 x[E] = 7 由 C 决定；换到 ABCDE / EDCBA 叠成 3 × 10 装不下；在 pos 里移动 D 得到同一布局的另一种编码；再在浏览器里写 relation() 和 longest_path() 并通过全部检查，8 个例子与课程引擎逐块一致。
why.en: Recorded from the real page: stepping to the H edge A→B (same order) and the V edge A→D (crossed order), clicking block E to see x[E] = 7 set by C; ABCDE / EDCBA stacking to 3 × 10 and overflowing; moving D in pos to get another encoding of the same packing; then writing relation() and longest_path() in the browser, passing every check, and matching the course engine block by block on 8 cases.
